name: road_boulder

interaction.note: south (bottom) side, facing north; the push rolls the boulder east to its resting spot

note: place on a 3-tile-wide dirt road (both 96x64, one scale/palette, bottom-aligned; swap image + collision). `collision` = closed state (full road width, all 3 tiles). Open: only the resting boulder at the right edge collides, passage = x 0-64 (the left two tiles). The dirt patch is a soft decal (woods dirt palette, alpha 0.8 in the middle fading to 0 toward its edges and the canvas border) so it blends into the road; the stones are opaque with outline + shadow. The open-state boulder is smaller than the closed one (as drawn in the source)
